# Store art (generated by `python3 Branding/make_brand_kit.py`)

All original, drawn in code (no stock / third-party images).

| File | Microsoft Store use |
|---|---|
| key_art_1920x1080.png, key_art_3840x2160.png | Screenshots / featured image (16:9) |
| key_art_ar_1920x1080.png | Arabic listing |
| key_art_delta_1920x1080.png | Egypt: Nile Delta add-on listing |
| hero_2160x1080.png | Hero image (2:1) |
| box_art_1080x1080.png | Box art (1:1) |
| poster_720x1080.png | Poster (2:3) |
| store_logo_300x300.png, app_icon_1080x1080.png | Store logo / app icon |
| background_clean_1920x1080.jpg | Clean background without the logo (trailers, social) |

MSIX tiles live in `installer/msix/Assets` (same script).
